id: \rMy husband is from Hoenn. He insists that gyms are better than the island trials.
en: \rMy husband is from Hoenn. He insists that gyms are better than the island trials.
it: \rMio marito viene da Hoenn. Insiste che le palestre sono meglio delle prove delle isole.

id: \bHala: Welcome to Iki Town, \PN. I heard you want to challenge the trials in Alola.
en: \bHala: Welcome to Iki Town, \PN. I heard you want to challenge the trials in Alola.
it: \bHala: Benvenuto a Iki, \PN. Ho sentito che vuoi affrontare le prove di Alola.

id: \bIs that a Z-Ring on your wrist? Yes, it looks very familiar. That must be the one that Tapu Koko stole from me.
en: \bIs that a Z-Ring on your wrist? Yes, it looks very familiar. That must be the one that Tapu Koko stole from me.
it: \bQuello che hai al polso è un Cerchio Z? Sì, mi sembra molto familiare. Dev'essere quello che Tapu Koko mi ha rubato.

id: \bDo not worry, you can keep it. If our guardian sees potential in you I see no reason to take it back.
en: \bDo not worry, you can keep it. If our guardian sees potential in you I see no reason to take it back.
it: \bNon preoccuparti, puoi tenerlo. Se il nostro protettore vede del potenziale in te, non vedo motivo di riprendermelo.

id: \bI'll give the guard the ok to let you challenge your first trial. You'll find it on Route 2.
en: \bI'll give the guard the ok to let you challenge your first trial. You'll find it on Route 2.
it: \bDirò alla guardia di lasciarti affrontare la tua prima prova. La troverai sul Percorso 2.

id: \bHala: I'll give the guard the ok to let you challenge it. You'll find it on Route 2.
en: \bHala: I'll give the guard the ok to let you challenge it.  You'll find it on Route 2.
it: \bHala: Dirò alla guardia di lasciarti affrontare la prova.  La troverai sul Percorso 2.

id: \bMy wife won't stop saying gym battles are inferior. The island trial is the one that's lame.
en: \bMy wife won't stop saying gym battles are inferior.  The island trial is the one that's lame.
it: \bMia moglie continua a dire che le lotte in palestra sono inferiori.  È la prova dell'isola a essere una noia.
